name: Mask R-CNN (outlines each object)
description: Finds each object and traces its outline, keeping touching objects apart. For separate things -- cells, nuclei, glands, parasites -- rather than regions of tissue. Starts from a network already trained on everyday photographs, so it learns from few examples.

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: Patches are resized so their shorter side is this long. Larger keeps small objects visible but needs more memory.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.

settings.label: Learning rate
settings.help: How big each learning step is. The default suits most projects.
